news.title: Why veterans choose Olin
news.summary_en: Olin Business School has doubled its enrollment of talented veterans in recent years. Most veteran MBA students attend WashU for free, using a combination of U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs Yellow Ribbon benefits and Olin scholarship dollars.

news.title: Preparing workers for the age of AI
news.summary_en: As artificial intelligence reshapes the workforce, the Brown School’s Jason Jabbari explains how higher education can prepare students with the skills to adapt and thrive while expanding economic opportunity.

news.title: Serving those who served
news.summary_en: WashU Medicine’s 80-year collaboration with Veterans Affairs St. Louis has spurred clinical innovation, scientific discovery and physician training.

news.title: New investments in humanities scholarship, academic inquiry
news.summary_en: Two new funding streams will examine how academic inquiry works and how collaboration bolsters the humanities.
